question: Should Android expose provider-config-only model management through new `models.configure` and `models.remove` Gateway RPCs, or should this be narrowed before becoming an advertised Gateway method surface?
rationale: The PR adds new advertised admin RPCs that mutate persisted model provider config, so the permanent API/source-of-truth contract is a maintainer product and compatibility choice.

options.title: Approve provider-config-only management
options.body: Accept the new RPCs as the Android path for editing only `models.providers.*.models`, while keeping allowlist-only models outside this screen after proof is added.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep the Android UI direction but avoid new advertised RPCs until the same behavior can reuse or extend an existing config-write contract safely.

options.title: Pause for broader model config design
options.body: Hold this PR if Android should also manage `agents.defaults.models` allowlists or broader provider setup in the same surface.

recommendation.title: Approve provider-config-only management
recommendation.body: Accept the new RPCs as the Android path for editing only `models.providers.*.models`, while keeping allowlist-only models outside this screen after proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal for the Android/Gateway model surfaces is recent authored and merged work by this login.
